name: io.github.Albertito-AI/research-resource-agent
title: Albert Tan Sin Hon Research Resource Agent
description: Legal scholarship, manuscripts, software and teaching by Albert Tan Sin Hon, with source records.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search Albert Tan Sin Hon's public scholarship, manuscripts, software and other profile-listed outputs, plus IBOL teaching guides. Returns source links, contributor credit, recorded status and rights. Deterministic word matching over a dated snapshot; the writings' full text is not searched.

query.description: Subject, work-title or project terms to match against resource titles, IDs, descriptions, categories and explicit subject keywords. Use 2 to 240 characters and at most 16 distinct meaningful terms, such as insurance or trust governance.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching resource records to return, from 1 to 8. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Retrieve one catalogue record or IBOL lesson summary by its exact ID from search_resources. Preserves source links, recorded citation details, contributor credit, limitations and licences. For the full companion lesson guide use get_ibol_lesson. This tool does not retrieve publications' full text.

id.description: Exact case-sensitive resource ID returned by search_resources, for example ibol-book or ibol-lesson-03. Selects a catalogue record or lesson summary; URLs are not accepted.

tools.name: get_ibol_lesson
tools.description: Retrieve the full companion teaching guide for one of eight IBOL lessons on financial law, insurance and trust governance, including its seminar plan, exercise, source locators, legal cut-off and separate teaching/book rights. Facilitator commentary is optional. This author-commissioned supplement is separate from the published book.

chapter.description: IBOL companion lesson number, an integer from 1 to 8. Returns that lesson's guide, learning goals, seminar plan, exercise and published-book locator.

include_facilitator.description: Set true to include the lesson's facilitator commentary. Defaults to false; the lesson guide and other teaching fields are still returned.
